# What a window's terminal sends, one line a case, in Go's escapes. Each case
# starts with nothing held and no command key pressed. The window is 80 by 24:
# tab "one" (showing) has pane p1 on the left, with the keys, and p2 on the
# right of a dividing line in column 40; tab "two" has p3. In a mouse report
# the column and the row count from 1.
